questions.stem: A 48 year old male presented to the casualty with a history of high-grade fever, cough, and diarrhea for 5 days. On examination pulse is 120 bpm, BP-70/40 mmHg, RR-22 cpm, and Spo2 88% on room air. He is transferred to ICU and started on oxygen support, inotropic support, and empirical antibiotics are started after drawing blood for culture. His initial ABG and electrolyte report are shown below.LFT and RFT are within normal limits. Identify the TRUE statement among the given options. pH- 7.2 PCO2-26 pO2- 93mmHg HCO3- 12mmHg Lactate-4.9 mmol/l Na/K/Cl – 139/3.6/110

options.label: A
options.text: This is a case of Type B lactic acidosis

options.label: B
options.text: There is presence of high anion gap metabolic acidosis + normal anion gap metabolic acidosis

options.label: C
options.text: Pyroglutamic acidemia occurs in patients taking aspirin.

options.label: D
options.text: L-lactic acidosis is due to formation of L-lactate by gut bacteria
